evals/types.ts.name: Scenario schemas
evals/types.ts.description: Defines zod schemas for scripted turns, steps, assertions and scenarios, all pure data.

evals/evals.test.ts.name: Tier 1 vitest gate
evals/evals.test.ts.description: Runs every scenario fixture against a fresh real server and fails with assertion details.

evals/vitest.config.ts.name: Evals vitest config
evals/vitest.config.ts.description: Pins repo root, server test setup file and serial file execution for the eval suite.

evals/providers/mock/scripted-plan.ts.name: Scripted model plan
evals/providers/mock/scripted-plan.ts.description: Builds the per-bot plan file the fake engine replays, resolving @key bot references to live ids.

evals/runners/run-evals.ts.name: Eval CLI entry
evals/runners/run-evals.ts.description: Loads scenarios, dispatches --golden and --live, runs scenarios in order and writes JSON and markdown reports.

evals/runners/run-scenario.ts.name: Scenario runner
evals/runners/run-scenario.ts.description: Boots a world, plays steps, freezes a snapshot, scores assertions and always tears the world down.

evals/runners/base-world.ts.name: Base eval world
evals/runners/base-world.ts.description: Provides shared steps, evidence reading and snapshot freezing for every world over one real server.

evals/runners/coordination-world.ts.name: Coordination world
evals/runners/coordination-world.ts.description: Launches the scripted verification server, creates bots, patches teams and runs routine and handoff steps.

evals/runners/local-vm-world.ts.name: Local VM world
evals/runners/local-vm-world.ts.description: Boots the real server with the in-repo VM fixture so computer-claim steps run without Podman.

evals/runners/api.ts.name: Eval HTTP client
evals/runners/api.ts.description: Wraps fetch in a small client and polls state with deadline-bounded waitUntil instead of sleeps.

evals/runners/run-skill-bench.ts.name: Skill bench runner
evals/runners/run-skill-bench.ts.description: Runs each fixture prompt with and without a skill through the scripted engine and builds the contrast report.

evals/scorers/assertions.ts.name: Assertion scorers
evals/scorers/assertions.ts.description: Scores each assertion kind as a pure function over the frozen world snapshot.

evals/scorers/snapshot.ts.name: Snapshot types
evals/scorers/snapshot.ts.description: Types the frozen evidence a run leaves behind: turns, handoffs, threads, sends and observations.

evals/scorers/skill-bench.ts.name: Skill bench scorer
evals/scorers/skill-bench.ts.description: Computes arm pass rates, token estimates, per-assertion deltas and non-discriminating or high-variance flags.

evals/reports/write-report.ts.name: Eval report writer
evals/reports/write-report.ts.description: Renders a markdown and a JSON report per run for release diffing.

evals/golden/run-golden.ts.name: Golden replay runner
evals/golden/run-golden.ts.description: Replays redacted golden fixtures and diffs each behavior trace against its committed baseline.

evals/golden/run-golden-cli.ts.name: Golden CLI adapter
evals/golden/run-golden-cli.ts.description: Parses --scenario, --out and --update-baseline and maps the outcome to an exit code.

evals/golden/golden.test.ts.name: Golden tests
evals/golden/golden.test.ts.description: Checks fixtures carry provenance, pass leak scans, match the redactor byte for byte and replay to baseline.

evals/golden/trace/behavior-trace.ts.name: Behavior trace
evals/golden/trace/behavior-trace.ts.description: Reduces a scenario run to tool order, argument keys, error flags, handoff tree and send admission.

evals/golden/trace/diff-trace.ts.name: Trace differ
evals/golden/trace/diff-trace.ts.description: Compares two behavior traces and returns one readable delta line per difference.

evals/golden/redact/redact-thread.ts.name: Thread redactor
evals/golden/redact/redact-thread.ts.description: Turns an exported real thread into a synthetic scenario with placeholders and aborts on any detected leak.

evals/golden/redact/leak-scan.ts.name: Leak scanner
evals/golden/redact/leak-scan.ts.description: Scans fixtures for emails, urls, paths, ips, secrets and hex blobs, reporting categories and never matched text.

evals/live/types.ts.name: Live tier schemas
evals/live/types.ts.description: Defines live scenario, invariant, threshold config and engine instance schemas for the opt-in tier.

evals/live/live-suite.ts.name: Live suite logic
evals/live/live-suite.ts.description: Adapts live scenarios to tier-1 shape, scores checks and applies score and drift thresholds.

evals/live/run-live.ts.name: Live tier runner
evals/live/run-live.ts.description: Gates on OMB_EVAL_LIVE, runs scenarios on a real engine, calls the judge and compares to a baseline.

evals/live/live-world.ts.name: Live eval world
evals/live/live-world.ts.description: Runs the real server with one real engine and derives evidence rows from thread messages.

evals/live/live-server.ts.name: Live server spawner
evals/live/live-server.ts.description: Spawns the real server in a temp data dir with one configured engine and an allowlisted environment.

evals/live/judge/judge.ts.name: Judge loader
evals/live/judge/judge.ts.description: Loads checksum-pinned judge prompts, renders them and strictly parses the JSON verdict.

evals/skill-bench/triggers.test.ts.name: Trigger set tests
evals/skill-bench/triggers.test.ts.description: Checks trigger-set splits, unique ids and term presence; no router runs the set yet.

evals/dream/score.ts.name: Dream scorer
evals/dream/score.ts.description: Grades a model's nightly-memory answer through the real parser and fact checks against expected and forbidden lines.

evals/dream/run-dream.ts.name: Dream live runner
evals/dream/run-dream.ts.description: Sends each dream case to a real model via its driver, gated on OMB_EVAL_LIVE, and reports score, time and cost.

evals/dream/live.ts.name: Dream case loop
evals/dream/live.ts.description: Runs dream cases one at a time with the real dream prompt and scores failed calls as empty answers.

evals/tool-choice/score.ts.name: Tool choice scorer
evals/tool-choice/score.ts.description: Scores which tool a turn reached first, whether it looked it up and whether a forbidden tool was hit.

evals/tool-choice/run-tool-choice.ts.name: Tool choice runner
evals/tool-choice/run-tool-choice.ts.description: Runs real-model turns per case on a live server, reads activity rows and cost, and prints a summary.

evals/tool-choice/context.ts.name: Tool list size probe
evals/tool-choice/context.ts.description: Measures bytes of the agents tool list a Claude turn sends up front, whole versus deferred.

evals/turn-routing/score.ts.name: Routing scorer
evals/turn-routing/score.ts.description: Compares classifyTurn's tier with the labelled tier and labels misses cautious or eager.

evals/turn-routing/score.test.ts.name: Routing tests
evals/turn-routing/score.test.ts.description: Pins today's classifyTurn verdict counts and miss lists on the labelled cases.

server/testing/setup.ts.name: Test setup
server/testing/setup.ts.description: Gives every test file a throwaway HOME and pins env flags so no test touches real data or network.

server/testing/fakes-self-contained.test.name: Fake isolation guard
server/testing/fakes-self-contained.test.description: Fails when a subprocess fake imports anything outside server/testing.

server/testing/room-handoff-agent.ts.name: Scripted room agent
server/testing/room-handoff-agent.ts.description: Plays scripted turns for the fake claude CLI through the real agents MCP proxy and logs evidence per turn.

server/testing/fake-driver.ts.name: In-memory fake driver
server/testing/fake-driver.ts.description: Provides a ProviderDriver whose events, snapshot failures and disposal a test controls directly.

server/testing/stream-script.ts.name: Stream script helper
server/testing/stream-script.ts.description: Streams a marker-chosen scripted reply of words, thinking, a tool or a failure in timed chunks.

server/testing/fake-claude-cli.ts.name: Fake Claude CLI
server/testing/fake-claude-cli.ts.description: Emulates the claude stream-json CLI with env-selected modes for failures, limits, resume, hooks and compaction.

server/testing/live-reply-cases.ts.name: Streaming reply cases
server/testing/live-reply-cases.ts.description: Defines marker-keyed scripted replies whose tokens let a check find each streamed message.

server/testing/events.ts.name: Event recorder
server/testing/events.ts.description: Records adapter events and resolves until(pred) when the proving event arrives, instead of sleeping.

server/testing/fake-openai-live.ts.name: Fake OpenAI Live
server/testing/fake-openai-live.ts.description: Serves a loopback stand-in for the OpenAI live-session HTTP and WebSocket API with failure injection.

server/testing/fake-codex-app-server.ts.name: Fake Codex app server
server/testing/fake-codex-app-server.ts.description: Emulates codex app-server JSON-RPC with env-selected modes for approvals, questions, crashes and limits.

server/testing/fake-acp-cli.ts.name: Fake ACP CLI
server/testing/fake-acp-cli.ts.description: Emulates an Agent Client Protocol CLI with env-selected modes for streaming, auth, questions and delegation.

server/testing/fake-claude-dump.test.ts.name: Capture integrity test
server/testing/fake-claude-dump.test.ts.description: Checks fake-CLI dump files stay complete JSON while another process writes them.

server/admission-golden.test.ts.name: Admission golden tests
server/admission-golden.test.ts.description: Freezes every admission table so a policy change must be paired with a visible test edit.

server/runtime-coordination.e2e.test.ts.name: Coordination e2e
server/runtime-coordination.e2e.test.ts.description: Scripts Chief and teammate turns by prompt match against a real server and checks assignments, events and restarts.

server/drivers/claude.test.ts.name: Claude driver tests
server/drivers/claude.test.ts.description: Spawns the fake claude CLI and asserts the canonical event stream, argv and env hygiene and interrupts.

server/drivers/agents-catalog-wire.test..name: Tool catalog goldens
server/drivers/agents-catalog-wire.test..description: Pins the agents tools/list wire byte for byte per profile and budgets its size.

server/system-prompt.test.ts.name: System prompt tests
server/system-prompt.test.ts.description: Checks prompt sections, the stable and volatile split and fixed prompt text.

server/prompt-cache-prefix.e2e.test.ts.name: Prompt cache test
server/prompt-cache-prefix.e2e.test.ts.description: Launches two threads of one bot and asserts they share the same system prompt prefix.

server/turn-prompt-budget.test.ts.name: Prompt byte budget
server/turn-prompt-budget.test.ts.description: Limits each fixed prompt section to a two percent byte drift from its baseline.

scripts/control-omb.ts.name: Control CLI and fixture
scripts/control-omb.ts.description: Launches the fake-engine verification server and exposes the omb control commands tests drive.

scripts/ci-linux-lanes.mjs.name: Linux CI lanes
scripts/ci-linux-lanes.mjs.description: Runs the Linux vitest shards, evals and packaged smoke side by side with per-lane timeouts and logs.

scripts/pre-push-check.mjs.name: Pre-push hook
scripts/pre-push-check.mjs.description: Runs lint and source guards on only the pushed files within a 30 second budget.

scripts/ci-scope.mjs.name: CI scope selector
scripts/ci-scope.mjs.description: Maps changed files to areas and selects which CI jobs, shards and lanes run.

scripts/check-model-manifest.mjs.name: Model manifest check
scripts/check-model-manifest.mjs.description: Validates the model manifest schema and requires updatedAt to advance when the file changes.

scripts/release-ci.mjs.name: Release CI gate
scripts/release-ci.mjs.description: Waits for a green full-matrix CI run on the release commit or starts one in a release lane.

scripts/capture-companion-fixtures.mjs.name: Companion fixture capture
scripts/capture-companion-fixtures.mjs.description: Records companion app test fixtures through a real harness and sidecar on the fake engine.

scripts/verify-live-reply.ts.name: Streaming reply verifier
scripts/verify-live-reply.ts.description: Streams scripted reply cases through the real renderer per engine and checks each frame.

scripts/testing/ci-retry-runner.ts.name: CI retry runner
scripts/testing/ci-retry-runner.ts.description: Gives listed flaky tests two retries in CI only and logs each retried test.

scripts/testing/ci-retry-summary.mjs.name: Retry summary
scripts/testing/ci-retry-summary.mjs.description: Reports tests that needed a retry in the job summary with an annotation each.

vite.config.ts.name: Vite and vitest config
vite.config.ts.description: Configures vitest workers, duration sharding, the retry runner and host-scaled timeouts.
